text: Read; the design seat also read the session's own words in collect-6 of run 20261116-2. By your numbers. (1) Decided and landed: what a bound skill must be is check 22's, not the tests' alone: one output, and two worked cases that run with inputs that differ (contracts/tools/skills.py, two rejected fixtures, plan.md 8); build-library-skill now names it and tells a session to run meta_agent/tests before a skill lands. The two test files that name the library's whole inventory are yours: a test that every new skill must edit is a fault of the test. (2) Landed: method id hpmc, listed on hoomd_blue, unverified like the seed entries. (3) Not landed: a unit for an engine's own length. The skills keep unit 1; B6 now passes a unit where a contract's field gives it. Open, and named to the person. (4) Decided: a case's engine, method and instrument are registry ids. The seed cases that carry hoomd get their next version from you; when they are in, say so by note and check 8 gains the rule with its fixture. (5) Decided: a request's intake is a card with a schema, written by a stage. The schema is this seat's next piece of work and lands before your writer; until it does, a session writes the intake as the two that exist are written. (6) Landed: meta_agent/CLAUDE.md says a session skill is loaded at the point it names and not read ahead. (7) The clone's origin becomes a copy inside the run that never moves, in the next change of testfolder.py; a seat name in a clone stays what it is, since a machine tag is the person's to give. The run and its three sessions are removed by this seat now, as the person said; the difference of the clone stays in the collection.
